meta.name: story-long-scan
meta.description: 长篇网文扫榜。分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台排行榜数据，提炼市场趋势与热门题材。触发方式：/story-long-scan、/长篇扫榜、「长篇什么火」「起点排行」。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析网文排行榜，发现热门题材与市场趋势
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在写网文，想了解当前什么题材最火
copy.tagline_en: Analyze web novel rankings to discover trending genres and market trends
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you write web novels and want to know what's trending

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会变成网络小说市场分析师。它能帮你扫榜分析起点、番茄、晋江等平台的排行榜数据，提炼热门题材和市场趋势，并给出可执行的选题建议。
howto.when: 当你输入“/story-long-scan”、“/长篇扫榜”、“长篇什么火”或“起点排行”等触发词时，Claude 会启动扫榜流程。

say.text: 帮我扫一下起点月票榜，看看最近什么题材火。
say.note: Claude 会采集起点月票榜数据并分析题材趋势。

say.text: 分析番茄男频阅读榜，找出新题材信号。
say.note: Claude 会采集番茄男频阅读榜并提取新出现的题材类型。

say.text: 对比起点和晋江的畅销榜，看看男女频差异。
say.note: Claude 会分别采集两个平台的榜单数据并做对比分析。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude becomes a web novel market analyst. It can scan and analyze ranking data from platforms like Qidian, Fanqie, and Jinjiang, extract market trends and popular themes, and provide actionable topic suggestions.
howto.when_en: When you enter trigger phrases like "/story-long-scan", "/长篇扫榜", "长篇什么火", or "起点排行", Claude will start the scanning process.

say_en.text: Scan Qidian monthly ticket ranking and tell me which themes are hot.
say_en.note: Claude will collect Qidian monthly ticket data and analyze theme trends.

say_en.text: Analyze Fanqie male frequency reading list and find new theme signals.
say_en.note: Claude will collect Fanqie male reading list and extract emerging themes.

say_en.text: Compare Qidian and Jinjiang bestseller lists to see gender differences.
say_en.note: Claude will collect both platforms' data and perform comparative analysis.
